Variants.Content: In the hands of nobles, a marriage contract is a calculation of land, military strength and peace, but in the hands of ordinary people, it is more often about work, household registration and a dowry that can be taken away. The bride and groom may not be able to choose each other, but every family understands that a marriage can settle old debts can also leave old grudges to the next generation.

Entry Betrothals and Dowries In the hands of nobles, a marriage contract is a calculation of land, military strength and peace, but in the hands of ordinary people, it is more often about work, household registration and a dowry that can be taken away. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
